events.name: Banana Leaf Flying
events.description: You on a sandy riverbank with big banana leaves tied along your arms like wings: you run off the edge, glide over a brown river while crocodiles leap up snapping below you, and land clinging to a leaning palm tree before sliding down to sit at its foot.

events.name: Cat Laundry
events.description: Your pet stands up on its hind legs and does the housework: rolls a blanket into the wardrobe, shuts a red bowl in the kitchen cupboard, then pulls the dry clothes off the balcony rail at night.

events.name: Cat on Ultra Bee
events.description: Your cat or dog stands up on a teal electric dirt bike, paws on the bars, and holds a long wheelie down an empty city road past graffiti walls, power pylons and the skyline at sunset.

events.name: Chased by Hyenas
events.description: You sprinting flat out straight at the camera across dry red savanna, a pack of spotted wild dogs right at your heels, leaping clean over one as it tumbles in the dust and running on with the pack all around you.

events.name: Gobble Gobble Dance
events.description: You and a friend side by side in a cosy living room, dancing in sync to the Gobble Gobble song: palms-up shrugs on every "gobble gobble", a side-on hip wiggle, fists punching out and back to the lens.

events.name: Grandpa Said He'd Handle Dinner
events.description: You, as the giant-armed grandpa in a black tank top, chopping a fish as long as the kitchen counter with a black cleaver, swinging it overhead and looking up at the camera between chops all the way down to the tail.

events.name: Hero Funk Dance
events.description: You do the Hero Funk head-bop dance in a bedroom: head bops, a low squat with fists up, a fist pump, a hop at the camera, a stop hand at the lens, a shrug, arms crossed and palms together, one full-length take.

events.name: King Jin
events.description: You stand still on a neon street at night with a lollipop stick between your lips while the whole crowd around you bows deep from the waist, then a slow close-up, a walk down a blue corridor with your hands in your pockets and a last look away against the skyline.

events.name: Water Flyboard Ride
events.description: Your partner flies in on a water-jet flyboard behind a boat, you step barefoot from the deck onto the board, you hug, and the two of you lift off together over the sea.
